latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cmo-onboarding-coach.

- Provides targeted onboarding and coaching for newly appointed CMOs, VPs of Marketing, Heads of Marketing, and fractional CMOs, tailored to 2026 role fragmentation.
- Covers role disambiguation (B2B vs B2C; demand-gen/brand/PMM/growth archetypes), stakeholder mapping, first 30 days listening tour, and audits of marketing stack, team, and budget.
- Addresses common CMO failure modes, tenure problems, and the critical CMO-CRO relationship.
- Designed to trigger based on relevant onboarding, alignment, and CMO-centric queries.
- Includes a structured diagnostic intake to tailor advice based on user’s role, business model, stage, reporting structure, and challenges.
